sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION While secondary sales of the Class A
ordinary shares by the Selling Shareholder will not have a dilutive effect on our shareholders, the issuance of Class A ordinary shares
to the Selling Shareholder pursuant to the Purchase Agreement will have a dilutive impact on shareholders. Dilution
results from the fact that the per share offering price of the Class A ordinary shares is substantially in excess of the net
tangible book value attributable to the existing shareholders. Net tangible book value represents the amount of our total assets
less our total liabilities, excluding goodwill and other intangible assets. Net tangible book value per Class A ordinary share
represents net tangible book value attributable to Class A ordinary shares divided by 11,717,133, the total number of our Class A
ordinary shares outstanding as of the date of this prospectus. As of June 30, 2026, we had
